injuries.note: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

injuries.name: Peter Skoronski
injuries.note: The Titans placed Skoronski (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: Jackson Slater
injuries.note: The Titans placed Slater (foot) on injured reserve Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: Tommy Townsend
injuries.note: The Titans placed Townsend (knee/Achilles) on IR on Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injuries.name: James Williams Sr.
injuries.note: The Titans placed Williams (groin) on injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Lane
injuries.note: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

injuries.name: Javontae Jean-Baptiste
injuries.note: The Commanders placed Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday.

injuries.name: Dyami Brown
injuries.note: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.name: Leo Chenal
injuries.note: The Commanders placed Chenal (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injuries.name: Javon Kinlaw
injuries.note: Kinlaw underwent season-ending surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Terry McLaurin
injuries.note: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jeremy McNichols
injuries.note: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Daron Payne
injuries.note: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.
